package g

type Number interface {
	~int | ~float64
}

type Pair[K comparable, V any] struct {
	Key K
	Val V `json:"val"`
}

type A[N]int // an array type, not a type parameter list

func Sum[T Number](xs ...T) (s T) {
	for _, x := range xs {
		s += x
	}
	return
}

var p = Pair[string, int]{"a", 1}
